_comment: Search ranges of the main comparison, as reported in the manuscript; values are stfr.train arguments. Candidates are trained with seed 20 for at most 30 epochs and compared on validation Recall@20 (scripts/run_cell.py). simgcl_lambda is selected once per dataset on the unmodified backbone (arm base) and shared by every method of the setting. TIDE and CausalEPP search the initial quality / conformity values (q, b) over {code default, (0, -3), (-1, -3), (-1, -5)} and the decay constant tide_tau over {3e6, 1e7, 3e7} seconds (34.7, 115.7, 347.2 days; the manuscript rounds them to 35, 116 and 347 days); entries without tide_q / tide_b use the code-default (q, b) of stfr/config.py. CausalEPP keeps the original paper / official code settings fixed: cepp_lambda 0.2, cepp_window 3 blocks (six months), cepp_smooth 256, cepp_alpha 0.5 (the stfr.train defaults). DDC searches the share of each user's training items, ranked by the frozen base score, that defines the preference direction. PDA trains each gamma with training-time validation at pda_alpha 0.1 and re-serves its checkpoint with every serve_grid alpha; PDA finals are trained anew with the selected alpha (reuse_sweep false). TPAB searches the authors' lists of K and lambda (official _tester.py) with the serving extrapolation fixed at the official 0.2. STFR finals are always trained anew (reuse_sweep false); on Douban-Movie, STFR with SimGCL is compared on the training-time validation subset (select_on_training_subset), every other arm on the full validation set. STFR_forecast is a serve-only variant of the STFR finals: fresh_forecast eta is selected on the mean validation Recall@20 of the three STFR finals; candidates within tie_pp percentage points of the best relative improvement over eta = 0 are ties, and the smallest eta among them is chosen.
